frozen_basis.O_ANCHORED: w(f0)=1, w(f1)=1, shared coordinate q; S_q = f0_q != I; <S_q, f1_q> = 1; occ=1
frozen_basis.O_COMM_S2: w(f0)=2, w(f1)=1; anchor a = supp(f1) subset supp(f0); b = other coord of f0; S_b != I and <S_b, f0_b> = 1; S_a != I and <S_a, f0_a> = 1; f1_a not in {I, S_a, f0_a}; occ=2
frozen_basis.O_PHANTOM: w(f0)=1, w(f1)=2; home h = supp(f0) subset supp(f1); borrow b = other coord of f1; S_h = I; S_b != I and <S_b, f1_b> = 1; f0_h != f1_h; occ=1
frozen_basis.pinned_comm_s2_handling: structurally inside B; reported with pinned=true; a T1 terminal must state the pinned/unpinned split explicitly because the pinned sector is the lemma-open sector
frozen_basis.predicates_verbatim_source: research/extensions/orion-qg/qg7c_classification.py :: m1_inventory (transcribed to witness geometry in RUNNER_DRAFT.py classify_block)
frozen_basis.symmetry_closure: predicates use only local symplectic products, common-relabeling letter equalities, nonidentity tests and supports; closed under per-qubit S3 letter relabelings, qubit permutations, block permutations; orientation involution maps O_PHANTOM <-> O_COMM_S2 (both in B)

instance_family.enumeration: itertools.combinations(range(1,16), 6) in lexicographic order; instance_id i in 0..5004; targets = [divmod(c,4) for c in combo]
instance_family.input_hash: sha256 of canonical compact JSON of the dense target list [[a0,a1]x6] in code order
instance_family.name: N2_DISTINCT_SIX_TARGET_CENSUS
instance_family.note: admitted R6M instances in general allow repeated targets; this census is the frozen distinct-target sub-family; registered repeated-target gap witnesses run only as controls

per_instance_procedure: 1. c2 = solve_six_targets(targets, max_support=2) -> (matching2, witness2); verify_witness must pass all checks
2. c1 = solve_six_targets(targets, max_support=1) -> (matching1, witness1); verify_witness must pass all checks
3. gap = c1.cost - c2.cost; gap < 0 is impossible (family containment) and is a CANNOT_CHECK-grade defect
4. classify RAW: per pair, assign roles f0/f1 by Tag labels (f0 label 0, f1 label 1), compute per-coordinate classes (alpha,beta), block shape per frozen predicates

5. RED: repeatedly delete class-(0,0) coordinates of weight-two frames; after each deletion assert pair anticommutation, Tag labels equal orientation, and exact recomputed cost equality via the solver's own cost functions
6. classify REDUCED witness; membership = at least one weight-two-containing block cleanly O_PHANTOM or O_COMM_S2
7. record pinned flag per obstruction block: some other block's frame member has a nonidentity letter with local symplectic 1 against the borrow-side Tag letter
8. emit one JSON result file; deterministic; no RNG
question: For every admitted support-one gap in the complete distinct-target n=2 census C(15,6)=5005, does the (reduced) canonical optimal support-two representative contain a block obstruction from the frozen basis B = {O_ANCHORED, O_PHANTOM, O_COMM_S2} restricted to B_gap = {O_PHANTOM, O_COMM_S2}?
